# Layout decisions: ingest API, storage and state (WS-01)

Every `[default chosen]` made in `docs/build/ws-01-ingest-api.md`, plus the inconsistencies found between the plan, the docs, the code and the sibling briefs while writing it. Repo paths unless prefixed `$S` (`/cursor/stores/bc-5bc79926-909c-4cfb-aa62-24b3a44735e2`). Hunter's GCP layout decision (new `house-scanning` project, state in `smp-substrate-tfstate-prod` under `house-scanning/<env>`, SMP GitHub WIF reused) is a decision, not a default, and is stated in the brief §1 item 4 and §3.7.

## 1. Decisions (`[default chosen]`)

| # | Area | Decision | Why | Briefs that must agree |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| W1-01 | PRs | two PRs: `ws-01/ingest-api` and `ws-01/multipart` (MULTIPART branch + `files:complete`) | no fixture has a file > 16 MiB (largest is 776 KB); the core API should not wait on XML multipart plumbing | WS-11, WS-14 |
| W1-02 | Storage layout | signed PUTs target `uploads/{captureId}/{path}`; on acceptance + last commit every listed file is copied server-side (generation-pinned) to `captures/{captureId}/{path}`; bucket `Delete` rule at 7 d on `uploads/`; `captures/` never lifecycle-deleted (Nearline at 30 d) | hosted-architecture's single deterministic key and its "lifecycle deletes unfinalized objects after 7 days" cannot both hold on one prefix (the rule would also delete finalized packets, `packet.json`, run artifacts, early blobs); SMP review §3 anticipated "a second prefix or custom_time"; a prefix split works identically on GCS, R2 and the volume | WS-00 (D-10 keys unchanged for readers), WS-02 (materializes `captures/`), WS-03 (`CommittedFile.key` for early workers) |
| W1-03 | `CommittedFile.key` | hook payload gains `key` (readable location now: `uploads/…` at commit, `captures/…` after promotion) | consequence of W1-02 | WS-03 |
| W1-04 | `Storage` additions | `copy`, `delete`, `initiate_multipart`, `signed_part_url`, `complete_multipart`, `abort_multipart`; `ObjectMeta.md5_b64: str \| None` | promotion, DELETE, MULTIPART; composite objects have no MD5 | WS-00 owner (additive commit), WS-03 |
| W1-05 | WIF pool per environment | pool `modal-<env>`, provider `modal`, runtime SA `hss-runtime-<env>`; `project_number` is a module input | avoids a shared pool + data source, so `terraform test` runs with a mock provider and dev/prod never share a principal set | WS-12 |
| W1-06 | WIF subject | `google.subject = "modal/" + workspace_id + "/" + environment_name + "/" + app_name`; condition on `workspace_id` and `environment_name` only | GCP rejects mapped subjects > 127 bytes; Modal's `sub` example is 144 chars; the app name must not be pinned because WS-12 composes apps with `app.include` | WS-12 |
| W1-07 | Bucket IAM placement | bucket bindings in `capture_bucket` (`object_admin_members`, `object_viewer_members`); SA bindings in `modal_wif` | no cross-module resource references; root wires them | WS-12 |
| W1-08 | Soft delete | `soft_delete_policy { retention_duration_seconds = 0 }` | PII erasure on `DELETE` must be real | WS-12, Base |
| W1-09 | Bucket extras | `AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload` at 1 d; CORS block only when `cors_origins` non-empty; labels `product, env, owner, data_class = pii, managed_by` | SMP labels contract; multipart hygiene | WS-12 |
| W1-10 | R2 lifecycle | set with `wrangler r2 bucket lifecycle add hss-captures-<env> --id uploads-ttl --prefix uploads/ --expire-days 7 --abort-multipart-days 1`; no Terraform module for R2 | R2 is a fallback; the Cloudflare provider is not in the stack | WS-12 |
| W1-11 | Static tokens | `CAPTURE_API_TOKENS = "<label>:<token>,…"`, token ≥ 32 chars, principal = label; cross-principal access → 403 `forbidden` | capture-scoped access with readable logs; 403 over 404 for debuggability during the hackathon | WS-11, WS-12 (secret content), WS-14 |
| W1-12 | JWT seam | `HSS_AUTH_MODE=static\|jwt`, `HSS_AUTH_JWKS_URL`, `HSS_AUTH_ISSUER`, `HSS_AUTH_AUDIENCE=capture-api`; PyJWT + JWKS; principal = `sub` | hosted-architecture §1 row 8 | WS-12, Base |
| W1-13 | GCP credential modes | `HSS_GCP_AUTH_MODE=wif\|adc_impersonate\|sa_key`; `sa_key` only as the documented fallback | SMP review §3 fallback; laptops need ADC impersonation | WS-12 |
| W1-14 | Limits | 1 GiB per capture, 256 MiB per file, 50 per batch, 2000 files, 1 MiB JSON bodies, finalize 8 MiB gzip / 48 MiB inflated, 20 open captures per principal, 8 concurrent long-polls per capture; rate limits 30/120/3000/120/10/30/120/10 per minute per §4.17 | hosted-architecture gives 2000 files and 16 MiB; the rest was silent | WS-11, WS-14 |
| W1-15 | Path rules | `RelPath` + `^[A-Za-z0-9._/-]{1,256}$`, no `//`, no trailing `/`, never `packet.json` | object-key safety across three backends | WS-14 |
| W1-16 | `contentType` per role | `keyframe\|still → image/jpeg` (+ `image/heic` for photo_only stills), binary roles → `application/octet-stream`, `stream → application/gzip`, `compat\|other` any of those or `application/json` | spec Appendix D formats | WS-14 |
| W1-17 | `meta` | optional, role-consistent (`keyframe`/`still`/`trueDepthFrame`), stored verbatim in `FileRecord.meta` | WS-02 `partial_from_metas`, WS-03 early reads | WS-02, WS-03, WS-14 |
| W1-18 | Re-registration | same sha: committed → `committed`, else fresh URL; different sha: committed → 409 `sha256_conflict`, else replace the record | hosted-architecture only defines the committed case | WS-14 |
| W1-19 | Multipart integrity | commit checks `bytes` only for MULTIPART objects (no MD5 on composite objects); paths recorded in `capturex.size_only_paths`; sha256 at WS-02's `validate` stage | GCS/R2 fact | WS-02, WS-03 |
| W1-20 | `etaS` | 200 for `awaiting_files`, 180 for `processing` | hosted-architecture examples | WS-14 |
| W1-21 | `X-Packet-Sha256` | optional; mismatch → 422 `packet_sha_mismatch` | the header is a client integrity aid, the server hashes anyway | WS-14 |
| W1-22 | `run_id` | `"run_" + sha256(packet bytes)[:16]`, computed by WS-01 at acceptance so `runId` is returned while `awaiting_files` | WS-03 §3 definition; WS-00 D-09 said `run_` + ULID (see I-03) | WS-00, WS-03 |
| W1-23 | Finalize validation depth | manifest stage only (`validate_manifest`); file hashing belongs to the pipeline's `validate` stage; interim `finalize_checks.py` (tap replay 1e-3, depth/confidence/features byte sizes) until WS-03 re-exports `validate_manifest` | hosted-architecture finalize budget 2 s; import rule forbids `server.api → server.packet` | WS-02, WS-03 |
| W1-24 | Events long-poll | poll every 500 ms with an in-process wake; `next` = last returned `seq` (or `after`); `wait` clamp 0–25; limit 100; WS-01 emits `files_committed`, `confirmation`, `failed {capture_expired \| file_changed_after_commit}` | hosted-architecture example semantics; `modal.Dict` has no pub/sub | WS-03, WS-11, WS-14 |
| W1-25 | Status derivation | capture status from the latest WS-03 run (`queued\|running → processing`, others 1:1) when a run exists | WS-03 owns run transitions; WS-01 never writes run state | WS-03, WS-10 |
| W1-26 | Result before ready | `200 ResultResponse` minimal body (`runId`, `status`, `profile`, empty lists) | polling clients prefer 200 with `status` | WS-11, WS-14 |
| W1-27 | Result pass-through | WS-10's `result.json` served unchanged except `status`, `runId`, `verdictUrl` (default profile verdict, 900 s), `previewUrl`, `reviewUrl`; not re-validated against WS-00 `ResultResponse`; `GET /captures/{id}/review` serves `review.html` | WS-10 keeps the snake_case `outcome` block (I-07) | WS-10, WS-14 |
| W1-28 | Amendments | allowed in `needs_views\|manual_review` only; one open at a time; `answers` ⊂ `viewsNeeded` ids ∪ `outcome.views_needed` ids ∪ `memberActions`; amendment `files[].path` packet-relative, upload path prefixed `amendments/{aid}/`; `packetId` must differ from the parent's | hosted-architecture describes the flow, not the guards | WS-03, WS-14 |
| W1-29 | Confirmations | `POST /captures/{id}/confirmations {fieldId, kind, value, imageId, clientAt}`; field ids `meter_number, panel_brand, main_breaker_amps`; idempotent per `(capture, fieldId)` via CAS; 409 `confirmation_conflict` on a different answer; 409 `capture_closed` in `complete\|failed\|expired`; event type `confirmation` (data without `value`); hook `on_confirmation` → WS-08 `policy.confirm(...)`; `GET …/confirmations` | coordinator alignment from WS-08 (its proposal was `{stillId, choice, typed}`) | WS-00 (`EventType`, models), WS-03, WS-08, WS-10, WS-14 (spec PR) |
| W1-30 | DELETE | tombstone `tomb:{cid}`; every later call and a replayed create → 410 `capture_deleted`; second DELETE → 204; both prefixes deleted | privacy; idempotency | WS-03 (`cancel_capture`), WS-14 |
| W1-31 | Devices | store tokens only (max 10 per principal); no push | hosted-architecture demo column | WS-10, WS-12 |
| W1-32 | Sweeper | `modal.Period(minutes=5)` `ingest_sweep`: expiry → `expired` + `failed` event; volume backend deletes `uploads/` > 7 d and `*.parts/` > 1 d; GCS/R2 never swept | lifecycle rules are the deletion mechanism where they exist | WS-03 (separate stage sweeper), WS-12 |
| W1-33 | Modal function | `hss-capture-api` app, `debian_slim` 3.12 image from `pyproject` extra `api`, `min_containers=1`, `max_containers=1`, `@modal.concurrent(max_inputs=200)`, `scaledown_window=300`, secrets `hss-<env>-api`, `hss-<env>-gcp`, volume `house-capture-pipeline` | single writer for `modal.Dict` state; SMP secret names | WS-03, WS-12 |
| W1-34 | Dict keys | `capture:`, `capturex:`, `file:`, `files:`, `idem:`, `amend:`, `confirm:`, `device:`, `tomb:`, `open:` in the shared `hss-<env>-state`; WS-03 prefixes untouched | one Dict per environment (WS-03 §12) | WS-03 |
| W1-35 | Replay client interim | `server/api/replay.py` with WS-11's flag subset until `server/eval/replay.py` lands | WS-01 acceptance cannot wait on WS-11 | WS-11, WS-14 |
| W1-36 | Health | `GET /v1/healthz {status, storage, state, wifTokenExpiresAt, version}`; 503 `credential_expired` within 5 min of the Modal token `exp` | WS-00 D-26; Modal tokens are static per container | WS-11, WS-12 |
| W1-37 | Volume upload token | `PUT /v1/uploads/{token}`, `token = b64url(json{key, md5, ct, exp}) + "." + hex(HMAC-SHA256(UPLOAD_URL_HMAC_SECRET, payload))`; bound `Content-Type`/`Content-MD5`; `400 BadDigest` | hosted-architecture §4 storage fallback | WS-12, WS-14 |
| W1-38 | Env names | `HSS_INGEST_*`, `HSS_AUTH_*`, `HSS_GCP_AUTH_MODE`, `HSS_HOOKS`, `HSS_STATE_DICT_NAME`, `CAPTURE_API_PUBLIC_URL`, `UPLOAD_URL_HMAC_SECRET`, `VOLUME_ROOT`, `R2_*` added to WS-00 `Settings` | WS-00 D-14 names kept; WS-04 style `HSS_<ws>_*` | WS-00 owner, WS-12 |
| W1-39 | Postgres | not built; DDL sketch in the brief §3.4 covers WS-01 tables and WS-03's `runs`/`stages`/`events` | plan says Postgres for prod; WS-03 says "WS-01 schema" | WS-03, WS-12 |
| W1-40 | Fixtures with stills | `yt-12Ks1idWj40` photo-only (the only store packet with stills) + a synthetic mini ARKit packet built from `example-packet.json` with `meter_close`/`meter_oblique` stills | index.json: every golden house has `stills: null` | WS-02, WS-03, WS-11, WS-14 |
| W1-41 | Terraform validation without GCP | module `tests/plan.tftest.hcl` with `mock_provider "google"` (Terraform ≥ 1.7); root stack stays WS-12's; a throwaway root in `/tmp` for the first `dev` apply | modules must be provable before the project exists | WS-12 |

## 2. Inconsistencies found (reported, not fixed)

| # | Where | What | Handling in the WS-01 brief |
|---|---|---|---|
| I-01 | `docs/hosted-architecture.md` §2.2 "object key is deterministic `captures/{captureId}/{path}`" + "Limits: a lifecycle rule deletes their objects after 7 days"; SMP review §4.2 `Delete … matches_prefix = ["captures/"]` | one prefix cannot carry both the 7-day delete of unfinalized uploads and the finalized packets, `packet.json`, run artifacts and early blobs that WS-00 D-10 and WS-03 also put under `captures/{id}/` | two-prefix layout W1-02; readers unchanged; needs `CommittedFile.key` (W1-03) |
| I-02 | `docs/hosted-architecture.md` §2.2 files example `role: keyframe_image` | spec Appendix A/D role is `keyframe` | 422 `role_unknown`, no alias (WS-00 D-08); spec PR owed by WS-14 |
| I-03 | WS-00 D-09 `runId = "run_" + ULID` vs WS-03 §3 `run_id = "run_" + sha256(packet.json bytes)[:16]` | two definitions of the same id | WS-01 follows WS-03 (W1-22); WS-00 owner to update D-09 |
| I-04 | WS-00 `server/contracts/jobs.py` `RunRecord`/`StageRecord`/`EventRecord` and `StateStore` (`put_run`, `upsert_stage`, `stale_stages`) vs WS-03 `server/orchestrator/models.py` + `RunStateStore` (different fields, status enums `queued…cancelled` vs `StageStatus`) | two owners of run state | WS-01 reads runs/stages/events only through WS-03's `RunStateStore`; status mapping in W1-25; WS-00/WS-03 to reconcile the models |
| I-05 | WS-03 `EventRecord.type` Literal = 6 values; WS-00 `EventType` = 9 (`files_committed`, `review_started`, `review_completed` missing in WS-03); WS-01 adds `confirmation` | WS-01's `files_committed` and `confirmation` events cannot be appended through WS-03's store as typed | WS-03 to widen the Literal to WS-00's `EventType` (+ `confirmation`) |
| I-06 | env names: WS-00 `STATE_BACKEND`/`STORAGE_BACKEND` (with `local`) vs WS-03 `HSS_STATE_BACKEND`; SMP review `STORAGE_BACKEND=gcs\|r2\|volume` | duplicate knobs | WS-01 uses WS-00's names and WS-03's `HSS_STATE_DICT_NAME`; WS-03 to drop `HSS_STATE_BACKEND` |
| I-07 | hosted-architecture result example camelCase (`viewsNeeded`, `relBound95`) vs plan §5 snake_case (`views_needed`, `recommended_placement`); WS-00 `ResultResponse`/`Outcome` camelCase; WS-10 keeps the `outcome` block snake_case | the device payload has two spellings | WS-01 passes `result.json` through without model validation (W1-27); WS-00/WS-10/WS-14 to settle one spelling |
| I-08 | SMP review §4.2 `google.subject = assertion.sub` for the Modal provider | Modal's `sub` (`modal:workspace_id:…:container_id:…`, 144 chars in Modal's own example) exceeds GCP's 127-byte subject limit → token exchange fails | concatenated subject (W1-06) |
| I-09 | SMP review §4.2 pool `modal` + provider `modal-<env>` (one pool for both envs) | a shared pool needs a data source or ordering between env stacks | pool per environment (W1-05) |
| I-10 | WS-02 §3 "`validate_manifest` … WS-03 re-exports it for WS-01's finalize"; WS-03 brief defines no such re-export; WS-00 import rules forbid `server.api → server.packet` | the seam has no owner | WS-01 calls `server.orchestrator.validate_manifest` when present, interim checks otherwise (W1-23); WS-03 to add the one-line re-export |
| I-11 | WS-14 §3.2 `flow: "photos"` for photo_only vs WS-00 `flow: guided\|photo`, WS-11 D-25, hosted-architecture | `photos` would fail `CreateCaptureRequest` | WS-01 accepts `photo` only; WS-14 to fix |
| I-12 | WS-14 `422 {code: "unsupported_format_version", supported: [...]}` vs WS-02 `format_version_unsupported`; `ApiError` rows have no `supported` field | two codes, one shape | WS-01 uses `format_version_unsupported` on create and finalize (W1-20 neighbourhood); WS-14 to align |
| I-13 | WS-08 §3 proposed `POST /captures/{id}/confirmations {stillId, choice, typed}` vs the coordinator's `{fieldId, value, imageId, clientAt}` | body shape | WS-01 maps `kind/value/imageId` → `choice/typed/still_id` in the hook (W1-29); WS-08 unchanged |
| I-14 | hosted-architecture events example returns seq 42–43 with `next: 43` | ambiguous whether `next` is last or last+1 | `next` = last returned seq (W1-24) |
| I-15 | Modal docs: `MODAL_IDENTITY_TOKEN` is injected once per container, ~48 h `exp`; hosted-architecture/SMP review assume a kept-warm API container | a long-lived API container loses GCS access when the token expires | healthz 503 + daily redeploy default (W1-36; brief §12) |
| I-16 | `$S/internal/data/packets/index.json`: every golden house `stills: null`; only `yt-12Ks1idWj40` has stills (6, photo_only, purposes `meter_surround`/`panel_surround`/`house_overview`, none `meter_close`) | the plan's "replay client uploads a fixture packet" cannot exercise `role: still` with meter purposes on a golden packet | W1-40 fixtures; WS-13 to add real stills |
| I-17 | WS-00 `Storage.list_prefix` vs WS-03 §1 `Storage.list` | method name drift | WS-01 implements WS-00's names |
| I-18 | hosted-architecture "storage rejects corrupted bytes with `400 BadDigest`" | true for single PUTs only; multipart parts and composite objects carry no MD5 | size-only commit for MULTIPART (W1-19) |
| I-19 | plan §6 WS-01 lists the Postgres tables under WS-01; WS-03 says `PostgresRunStateStore … (WS-01 schema)`; WS-00 `StateStore` Protocol also carries run/stage methods | three owners of the run/stage schema | DDL sketch in WS-01 §3.4 (W1-39); WS-00/WS-03 to converge |
| I-20 | WS-10 §1 start gate names `server/common` interfaces `put`, `signed_url`, `set_status` "from WS-01's contract" | those names do not exist in WS-00 (`put_bytes`, `signed_get_url`) or WS-01 (status is derived from the run, no `set_status`) | WS-10 to use WS-00's `Storage` names and WS-03's run status; WS-01 derives status (W1-25) |
| I-21 | plan §6 WS-01 "commit does HEAD + generation pinning"; R2 has no generations | `generation` is the `ETag` on R2 and `mtime-size` on the volume | `ObjectMeta.generation: str` semantics per backend (brief §3.3) |
| I-22 | WS-03 §1 lists `Storage` backends `gcs\|r2\|volume\|local` as a WS-00 deliverable; WS-00 ships only `LocalFsStorage` | cloud backends are WS-01's | brief §3.3 |
